_: needs[]: every fact required. ceases_on[]: any fact that retires it. assigned_to[]: roles. provisions[]: {key} always applies; {key,when:[facts]} only in that context. leads_to[]: risks this one CAUSES or makes worse — a different edge from the facts that establish it. Cycles are allowed and meaningful: a control nobody dares use and a control that does not exist each produce the other. layer: 'operational' entries are established by facts; 'corporate' entries are established by the operational ones that lead INTO them — the answer to 'why does this matter' three or four hops up. The corporate tier is the register a board already keeps. needs_any[]: established if ANY of these hold (needs[] is ALL). layer 'inherent' entries are true because the thing EXISTS — reducible, not removable, and the reason a well-run estate still has a register.

items.statement: An autonomous system operates in the estate
items.why: Running one at all is a decision, and this is the entry that names it. No control removes it — every control below changes its size.
reduced_by: every control below — all of which reduce it

leads_to.why: the decision to operate it is the exposure this names

items.statement: Stopping the agent is itself a service interruption
items.why: Even a stop that takes one action and one minute is an outage. A perfect stop control does not make stopping free.

leads_to.why: the cost of using the control is part of resilience

items.statement: Personal data is within reach of an automated actor
items.why: Not a failing — a scope. The moment personal data is reachable by something that is not a person, the regime applies to everything downstream.

leads_to.why: scope is what the regime attaches to

items.statement: Special category or payment data is within reach of an automated actor
items.why: The same scope, narrower grounds, and a materially larger number behind any incident.
reduced_by: a DPIA that names this actor

leads_to.why: narrower grounds, same attachment
this is where the number comes from

items.statement: A person is affected by something the organisation automated
items.why: Whether it decides or merely informs, a person is on the other end of it. That is true of a well-run system too.
reduced_by: a human with authority to overturn
measuring how often the human differs

leads_to.why: a person on the other end is what customer harm means

items.statement: The production estate can be changed by an agent
items.why: They hold the estate. A change they did not make can still be one they must live with.

leads_to.why: a system that can change production is the thing being delegated to
you cannot have an irreversible change without the power to change

items.statement: Regulated data is readable by an agent
items.why: Read access to personal data is the DPO's subject as much as the CISO's, and they escalate differently.

leads_to.why: read access is the step before write access, and the same principal holds both

items.statement: The operator cannot state what the agent is entitled to reach
items.why: Bounding the problem needs the surface, and the surface is not written down.

leads_to.why: you cannot review a scope nobody has written down
an unenumerated reach is how customer systems end up inside it

items.statement: Stopping the agent takes more than one action
items.why: Each extra action is another thing to get right while something is going wrong.

leads_to.why: a multi-step stop is the one nobody has timed

items.statement: What else stops when the agent stops is unknown to the people who would stop it
items.why: They must decide to stop it without knowing the cost of stopping it.

leads_to.why: unknown effects are an incomplete map by another name
the operator's uncertainty becomes the estate's

items.statement: The operator cannot identify who authorises a stop
items.why: Finding out is work, and it happens while the agent is still running.

leads_to.why: nobody named is how authority ends up with a group
the operator's search is the organisation's gap

items.statement: No procedure exists for the period after a stop
items.why: Stopping it is the start of the work, and the rest has never been written down.

leads_to.why: a procedure that does not exist has not been exercised
the missing procedure IS the undefined half

items.statement: What the agent did cannot be reconstructed
items.why: Diagnosis starts from a record that is not being kept; so does an investigation.

leads_to.why: no reconstruction and partial reconstruction differ by degree
you cannot account for what you cannot reconstruct

items.statement: The agent's actions cannot be attributed to a person
items.why: Accountability requires demonstrability, and there is no line from an action to somebody answerable.

leads_to.why: unattributable and team-attributable are the same gap at two depths
no name on an action is no answer to 'by whose authority'

items.statement: The organisation acts through a system that acts without a person approving each action
items.why: Delegating action to a system that decides is a choice about how the organisation operates.
reduced_by: nothing below removes it — controls change what it does, not that it decides

leads_to.why: records change because nobody approves the change
acting without approval is what makes the decision the system's
running it at all is the decision this names
autonomy is what most of the regime attaches to

items.statement: Regulated data is modifiable by an agent
items.why: Modification is a different exposure from reading: integrity, not only confidentiality.

leads_to.why: the modification is what alters the record

items.statement: The scope of the agent's access cannot be reviewed
items.why: Review, rating and treatment all rest on a scope nobody holds.

leads_to.why: an unreviewable scope cannot be sized against a window

items.statement: Customer-facing systems are reachable by the agent
items.why: The service owner carries the customer impact; the CISO carries the posture that now extends to it.
reduced_by: scoping the agent to internal systems

leads_to.why: customer-facing usually means outward-facing

items.statement: The time a stop takes is unknown to the people who would perform it
items.why: They are the only people who can measure it, and until they do the number exists nowhere.
reduced_by: an estimate — which is not a measurement

leads_to.why: an unmeasured time cannot be compared to anything

items.statement: The dependency map behind the stop control is incomplete
items.why: A partial map is the one that surprises you, because it reads as a map.

leads_to.why: a partial map is the one that surprises you

items.statement: Stop authority sits with a group rather than a person
items.why: A group cannot be paged. The SRE finds that out during the incident.
reduced_by: a rota with one name at a time

leads_to.why: a group cannot hold what one person must exercise

items.statement: Some changes the agent makes cannot be reversed by the operator
items.why: Undo is the operator's whole toolkit for a bad change, and for this class it is empty.
reduced_by: a gate on the irreversible class

leads_to.why: irreversible and partly-reversible are the same class seen twice
undo missing at the operator is recovery missing at the estate

items.statement: The post-stop procedure has never been exercised
items.why: A procedure never run is a hypothesis about a bad day.

leads_to.why: unexercised is undefined in the only way that matters

items.statement: Only part of what the agent did can be reconstructed
items.why: A partial record answers the easy questions and runs out at the one that matters.
reduced_by: raising the retention or the detail

leads_to.why: a partial record runs out at the question that matters

items.statement: The agent's actions reach a team rather than a person
items.why: A team is closer than a service account and still not a name on a decision.
reduced_by: a named owner for the account

leads_to.why: a team is not a name on a decision

items.statement: Records the organisation answers for can change without a person deciding they should
items.why: The organisation is answerable for those records whether or not anybody chose the change.
reduced_by: nothing below removes it while both facts hold

leads_to.why: the record is what the regime asks about
the record is somebody's

items.statement: A decision about a person is made without a person making it
items.why: This is where the system stops being infrastructure. The DPO's route to the board exists for exactly this.
reduced_by: a human with authority to overturn

leads_to.why: once the system decides, the human sign-off is what oversight rests on
this is what customer harm looks like in practice
and it is the provision most often cited

items.statement: The agent can reach systems outside the estate
items.why: Egress is the difference between a contained failure and an exfiltration.

leads_to.why: egress is what makes a loss unbounded
and what makes it visible outside

items.statement: The stop capability cannot be compared to any exposure window
items.why: Sizing the control depends on a number nobody has.
reduced_by: sizing to an assumed worst case

leads_to.why: a control nobody can size is a claim nobody can make

items.statement: Using the stop control has consequences the estate has not mapped
items.why: A control with unmapped consequences is one people hesitate over — which is how a working control goes unused.

leads_to.why: a control people hesitate over is a control that is not used

items.statement: No role holds the authority the stop control requires
items.why: Assigning authority is theirs to do; nobody below can grant it to themselves.

leads_to.why: unassigned authority arrives at the top unowned
a control nobody may use is a control that does not work

items.statement: Part of what the agent changes can only be partly recovered
items.why: Partial recovery is the case nobody rehearses, because it is neither of the two they planned for.
reduced_by: identifying which changes fall in it

leads_to.why: partial recovery is still not recovery

items.statement: The organisation could not account for what its agent did
items.why: After an incident it is asked what happened and by whose authority. Both answers depend on records.
reduced_by: nothing below removes it until the records exist

leads_to.why: this is accountability failure, stated
and the regime's first question

items.statement: Oversight of a decision about a person may be nominal rather than real
items.why: A person signing off what a system produced is oversight only if they can realistically disagree with it.
reduced_by: measuring how often the human differs

leads_to.why: nominal oversight is harm nobody caught

items.statement: The agent cannot be stopped
items.why: The SRE is the person who would have to do it.
reduced_by: isolating it at the network layer

leads_to.why: no stop path is why none has ever been demonstrated
the organisation cannot claim what the operator cannot do

items.statement: No individual is accountable for the decision to stop the agent
items.why: An exposure with no owner arrives here by default rather than by decision.
reduced_by: naming an owner at any level below

leads_to.why: an unowned decision is an unanswerable question

items.statement: Recovery is not available for part of the agent's action space
items.why: Most of the control set assumes detect-then-restore. Here that assumption does not hold.
reduced_by: moving the control earlier — approval, simulation, scope

leads_to.why: no recovery is what makes an outcome permanent
if recovery is unavailable the post-stop half has nothing to do

items.statement: The estate has no demonstrated means of interrupting the agent
items.why: An intervention capability never carried out is a claim, not an assurance.

leads_to.why: undemonstrated in production is at best demonstrated elsewhere
an undemonstrated control cannot support a claim made at board level

items.statement: Some outcomes of the agent's operation are permanent
items.why: Accepting an exposure that can be repaired and one that cannot are different decisions.
reduced_by: nothing below removes it — the class of change is a property of the domain

leads_to.why: permanence is what removes the ceiling
and what recovery cannot reach

items.statement: The recovery half of the stop control is undefined
items.why: The register records a stop capability and stops there; the time that hurts is after it.

leads_to.why: the estate's gap is the organisation's missing plan

items.statement: The stop control has been proved only outside production
items.why: A rehearsal in test is real evidence and not the same evidence. Production is where the dependencies are.

leads_to.why: a test-only rehearsal leaves production undemonstrated

items.statement: The organisation cannot state whether it can halt a system it operates
items.why: A regulator, an insurer or a customer will ask, and it must be answerable here.
reduced_by: nothing below removes it until both are true

leads_to.why: this is the sentence the board cannot say
and the reason service may not come back

items.statement: The organisation has no plan for the period after the agent is stopped
items.why: Reportable clocks and customer-visible outage both run through the part nobody has planned.
reduced_by: nothing below removes it until the procedure exists

leads_to.why: the recovery half is the resilience half

items.statement: Regulatory exposure — the organisation may be operating outside obligations it is subject to
items.why: The board's question is not whether a control is missing. It is whether the organisation is currently outside something it is answerable to, and whether it could tell.
reduced_by: a defensible record of what was decided and when

items.statement: Customer harm — customers may be affected by decisions or changes nobody made
items.why: The exposure the organisation is judged on publicly, and the one a product function owns before a security function does.
reduced_by: a human with authority to overturn
a route for a customer to contest

items.statement: Operational resilience — the organisation may be unable to restore a service it depends on
items.why: Not whether an incident happens, but whether the organisation comes back from one, and how long that takes.

items.statement: Unquantified financial exposure — the organisation cannot price its own downside
items.why: An exposure with no ceiling cannot be insured, provisioned for, or traded off against the cost of fixing it.

items.statement: Accountability failure — the organisation cannot demonstrate who decided what
items.why: Every regime here asks the same question after the event: what happened, and by whose authority. Both answers are records or they are nothing.

items.statement: Loss of control — the organisation operates a system it may not be able to stop or explain
items.why: The one that belongs at the top by its nature. Running an autonomous system at all is a decision, and this is the entry that names it.
reduced_by: nothing below removes it while the system runs — controls change its size
